IMPORTANT_READ_FIRST: 'Original NyayaMind' has TWO defensible readings in this repository and they are NOT the same system. Both are documented below. O-CODE is the original historical CODEBASE (root commit 0e37525). O-CFG is 'NyayaMind v0', the CONFIGURATION baseline the project's own documentation uses (HEAD code, five levers at their un-evidenced defaults). Almost every controlled experiment in this project measures O-CFG; exactly one (the claim-parser comparison) measures O-CODE. Never quote a number from one as if it described the other.

parser_version.act_resolution: sentence-level unambiguous, then field-wide unambiguous; never invented

ladder: fuzzy: same provision_type+provision_number, Jaccard act-word overlap >= 0.8

verifier_method.premise: raw canonical_text, UNLABELED (equivalent to HEAD premise_framing='bare')
verifier_method.label_order_source: model.config.id2label read at load time; ValueError on any unexpected label

correction_method.mechanism: whole-paragraph LLM regeneration, instructed to change ONLY the flagged sentence
correction_method.trigger: CONTRADICTED (any confidence) OR NOT_ENOUGH_INFORMATION with sub_reason=='low_confidence'; never NO_EVIDENCE; never high-confidence genuine neutral
correction_method.scope: first flagged claim only, max 1 attempt
correction_method.reverification: present — re-parse full corrected text, first-match replacement by (provision_type, provision_number, act_norm), re-match evidence, re-verify with bare premise + full-sentence hypothesis; max 1 pass

safety_gates.scope_unflagged_claim_preservation: PRESENT — pipeline.py:133-153, full claim_text must reappear verbatim; violation discards corrected text

prompts.generation_system: You are drafting only the "Statutory Grounding" section of an Indian court judgment summary. Given the case facts, write ONE short paragraph (3-6 sentences) naming the specific statutes, sections, or articles that apply to this case and briefly stating what each one requires. Output ONLY that paragraph. Do not include an issue, arguments, decision, or explanation. Do not use markdown or headings.
prompts.correction_system: You are revising a single sentence in the "Statutory Grounding" section of an Indian court judgment summary. You will be given the full original paragraph, one flagged sentence that is unsupported or contradicted by the cited law, and (if available) the actual text of the relevant statute. Rewrite ONLY the flagged sentence so it is consistent with the statute text provided. Return the FULL paragraph with every other sentence copied verbatim/unchanged, and only the flagged sentence modified. Output only the paragraph, nothing else.
prompts.correction_user_no_evidence_variant: No supporting statute text is available in the evidence corpus for this claim.
prompts.nli_premise_template: NONE — raw canonical_text passed directly as the premise string
prompts.nli_hypothesis_template: NONE — raw claim_text passed directly as the hypothesis string
prompts.chat_wrapper: tokenizer.apply_chat_template(messages, tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=True) for both generation and correction
